Hi there!

Thank you so much for your beautiful and thoughtful words! We’re truly honored to hear that Nebula could bring light and stability during such an important moment of self-discovery — that means more than we can say 💜
It’s amazing to know the experience helped you feel grounded and connected to your purpose. If you ever want to explore further or need support along the way, feel free to reach out at support-appstore@asknebula.com — we’ll be here for you.

Grateful to share this path with you,
Nebula Team🔮️

reviews.title: No pay, NO PLAY????
reviews.text: Am i not supposed to use the app if i don't pay that $7 weekly? I can't navigate passed paying that money. WTH! Lol
reviews.reply: Hi there, Thank you for your review. We’re sorry to hear that this experience has been confusing and frustrating for you. You’re not required to pay to use Nebula. The app includes free features that can be accessed without making a purchase, and any paid options are completely optional. You should be able to close the offer screen and continue exploring the app without subscribing. We’d really like to help you navigate this properly and check why the payment screen keeps appearing. Kindly reach out to us at support-appstore@asknebula.com, and we’ll be happy to assist you. Warm regards, Nebula Team 🔮
